sermon.title: Turn Away From Opposing Arguments 12/16/2018
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer applies 1 Timothy 6:20 to opposing arguments of science falsely so called, from Piltdown man to the 1970s ice-age scare, and shows Bible truths science later confirmed. God’s own method is observation and witnesses, and eternal life is knowing God and being made a new creature.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: He says “second Kings 16 17 and Elijah” for Elisha’s servant seeing the chariots (2 Kings 6:17); his words kept, the correct passage linked. Historical dates (Supreme Court in the 1840s, Copernicus 1475, Harvey 1620) are kept as spoken and were not checked.
